column1: # The claimed server lines, one row per line, as the pair every container check needs: the target
# framework this plugin is built for and the server image that runs it.
# It is a file rather than a list inside each workflow because more than one check needs the pair,
# and two copies of it disagree the first time a line moves. What a workflow holds instead is the
# framework it is already working from, and it asks here for the rest.
# The 12.0 entry is a release candidate. docs/compatibility.md says so in its own words and this
# file does not repeat the argument.
# THE THIRD COLUMN IS THE FLOOR SERVER, WHICH IS A DIFFERENT QUESTION FROM THE SECOND. The second is
# a server of the line, and every check that wants one server of a line asks for it. The third is the
# OLDEST server the line's claimed `targetAbi` names, which is the one an install has to work on for
# the claim to mean anything, and it is what `.github/workflows/release-install.yaml` asks for. A
# `targetAbi` of `A.B.C.D` names the server version `A.B.C`, which is the same reading
# `.github/workflows/abi-floor.yaml` makes of the same field.
# A DASH MEANS THAT LINE'S FLOOR HAS NO PUBLISHED SERVER IMAGE, and it is written here rather than
# discovered by a failed pull, so that an absent image is a fact somebody declared and a failed pull
# stays a failure. The 12.0 line is in release candidates: there is no `jellyfin/jellyfin:12.0.0` to
# install anything on, and the day one is published is the day this dash becomes a tag.
